name: dscoll_lane_w_rt-rtm-c57fb7c06
purpose: ds-coll M5 re-route of dsfd_coll_lane_w (432 x 336.96, S81 v8 slot): g2 (0fdf6f3c2) GRT-0116 -- hotspot = west end of the row-4/5 channel (x 20-40, y 220-260; GRT 19/18 per gcell, 122 + 18 overflowed gcells): the dictionary-order macro fill split the replay buffer's 553-bit word across BOTH columns (u_rb g_t0/2/4 E, g_t1/3 W), so its read/write slices converged horizontally through 22 um row channels with M2/M4 blocked over the macros under the M5 cap. Fix: one memory per column (u_rb's 5 slices stacked in the W column next to the gearbox it feeds, u_fifo's 5 in the E column next to li_d), so each 553-bit word is distributed vertically (M3/M5) along its column and only the registered W<->E datapaths cross a column (~1.4k bits over ~184 um of channel = ~6.4k H tracks, 0.22). RTL: reset synchroniser replicated per consumer (6 kept copies; was one 6,822-load net); lane-pair bench gates it.
